title: Basic Port Scanning Detection
story: An attacker is scanning the network using Nmap. Students must identify scanning activity from logs and understand reconnaissance techniques.

tasks.title: Run Packet Capture
tasks.description: Capture traffic on the monitored interface while the scan is occurring.
tasks.hint: Use tcpdump or tshark to capture packets.

tasks.title: Analyze Logs
tasks.description: Review network logs for signs of repeated connection attempts.
tasks.hint: Look for many ports touched by the same source.

tasks.title: Detect Scan Pattern
tasks.description: Identify the behavior that indicates an Nmap-style port scan.
tasks.hint: A scanner often touches many ports in a short time window.

tasks.title: Identify Attacker IP
tasks.description: Determine the source IP responsible for the scan.
tasks.hint: Group captured packets by source address.

tasks.title: Explain Attack Behavior
tasks.description: Explain how the scan supports reconnaissance before an attack.
tasks.hint: Describe how open port discovery helps attackers plan next steps.
